mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS unitName, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, p.name AS position, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.dob AS dob FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE e.id = #{id} GROUP BY e.id, c.name, u.name, p.name ORDER BY e.id
